name: refyard-kunkun
description: Refyard Git workbench custom view for Kunkun

kunkun.name: Refyard Git Workbench
kunkun.shortDescription: A scoped Git workbench backed by an explicit Refyard session.
kunkun.longDescription: The view reuses Refyard's GitService contract through a privileged backend process. The backend owns the session token; the renderer only receives a kkrpc service proxy.
